name: Rasa Juknevičienė - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on Hybrid warfare and the protection of the EU’s territorial integrity and critical security and defence infrastructure
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how the EU should fight hybrid warfare: hostile actions by states like Russia that stay below open war, such as cyberattacks, sabotage, disinformation and drone intrusions. It asks for faster detection, better sharing of intelligence between countries, stronger protection of power, transport and internet infrastructure, and a more coordinated response with NATO. It also wants tougher sanctions and a single EU point of coordination. This is a set of recommendations, not a new law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission, Council and countries to act.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, EU agencies, infrastructure operators and NATO partners.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the High Representative and the Commission for follow-up.
